  <statement>Plump helmet carries `MATERIAL_REACTION_PRODUCT:DRINK_MAT`, so it satisfies the one reagent condition `BREW_DRINK_FROM_PLANT` imposes on its plant, and is brewable on this install. It also carries `SEED_MAT`, which is what the reaction's seed product resolves through.</statement>

Recorded so the next reader does not have to re-derive it. See `brewing-chain-from-raws`.</note>

<doctrine_entry id="autofarm-semantics" scope="universal" status="verified">
  <topics>
    <topic>farming</topic>
    <topic>seeds</topic>
    <topic>food</topic>
  </topics>
  <statement>DFHack autofarm sets what each built farm plot grows from plant stock alone, in the CURRENT season's slot only, about every 53 running ticks (nothing happens while the game is paused). Each crop has a level, a count of plants (plants and their growths, in barrels and stockpiles too; items inside a building, rotten ones, drinks and seeds do not count); 0 means never plant it. A crop is eligible when it can be planted now (the season allows it and it will finish growing in season), the fort holds at least one of its seeds (there is no seed floor), it suits the plot's underground or surface biome, and its stock is below its level. With one plot: it keeps the plot's current crop while that crop is eligible, otherwise it moves to the eligible crop with the lowest raw index, and when no crop is eligible the plot is left fallow (no crop). Only plump helmet is edible raw among the underground crops; the others brew, mill or spin. Stock counts after brewing fall again, so a crop is planted again once its plants are drunk.</statement>
  <note>The 30-seed floor (seed-stock-never-falls) cannot be expressed in autofarm; it stays with the kitchen ban and the brewing orders. Settings live in the world save. Read from source and the install's docs, not observed running on this fort yet.</note>
  <sources>
